steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish and verify app-meta.json configuration values for AC Resizer with the package name com.acresizer.app.

steps.title: Verify settings.gradle
steps.description: Confirm root module inclusion configurations align with Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Establish Top-Level build.gradle
steps.description: Verify Google and Maven Central repositories with AGP 8.3.2 configurations.

steps.title: Configure App Module build.gradle
steps.description: Ensure compilation configs target SDK 34, set the namespace and applicationId to com.acresizer.app, and declare Java 1.8 compatibility.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest Integration
steps.description: Validate AndroidManifest.xml package paths, application label for AC Resizer, launchers, and permissions inside valid Android namespace configurations.

steps.title: Review Resource Background Drawables
steps.description: Maintain existing layout styles, button graphics, input card border stroke XML configurations.

steps.title: Update UI layout with AC Resizer Branding
steps.description: Revise activity_main.xml to incorporate updated header bars, title labels, sliders, and standard preset controls with AC Resizer styling.

steps.title: Update Package and Class Imports in MainActivity.java
steps.description: Refactor package declarations and title strings inside MainActivity.java to refer correctly to com.acresizer.app.

steps.title: Implement Camera/EXIF Orientation Parsing
steps.description: Provide helper methods in MainActivity.java to read EXIF orientation from photo streams to avoid unintended portrait-to-landscape auto-rotations.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Rotate Feature
steps.description: Handle real-time rotation operations on the source image and preview output layouts safely.

steps.title: Build Dynamic App Theme Customizer
steps.description: Add support for custom dynamic themes (Classic Blue, Dark Slate, Forest Green, Royal Purple) with visual feedback.

steps.title: Program Border & Outline Canvas Renderer
steps.description: Develop a precise border painter which overlays solid color borders inside the image bounding box.

steps.title: Code the Photo Enhancer Algorithm
steps.description: Apply contrast scaling factor matrixes and brightness levels using ColorFilters on the processed bitmap outputs.

steps.title: Building AC Resizer
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final stable, upgraded AC Resizer APK.
